name: vscode-drawio-ai
description: Draw.io in VS Code with an AI that edits your diagrams live. Fork of hediet/vscode-drawio.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace settings cannot load custom libraries or plugins, or change which Draw.io app the editor loads.

chatParticipants.name: drawio
chatParticipants.description: Edit the open draw.io diagram live

languageModelTools.name: drawio_get_diagram
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the open draw.io diagram (current page) as structured JSON: cells with ids, kind, label, style, geometry, parent, edge source/target, plus the user's current selection. Call this before editing. Use scope='selection' to focus on what the user selected (adjacent cells are included and marked context=true).

languageModelTools.name: drawio_apply_operations
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply a batch of edits to the open draw.io diagram in ONE undoable step; the user sees them live. Batch everything for one request into a single call. New cells get a tempId you can reference later in the same batch (e.g. add two shapes then an edge between them). Atomic by default: if any op fails, nothing is applied and per-op errors are returned so you can fix and retry. Returns new ids for every tempId.

items.description: One edit. Set `op` and only the fields that operation uses (listed in each field's description).

tempId.description: [addShape, addEdge, group] Your own handle (e.g. "$db") for the new cell. Later operations in the SAME batch can use it anywhere an id is expected.

id.description: [update] Id of the cell to change.

ids.description: [delete, move, resize, group, ungroup, align, distribute, zOrder, layout] Target cell ids.

label.description: [addShape, addEdge, update, group] Plain text; use \n for line breaks. Simple HTML is kept as-is when the style has html=1.

style.description: [addShape, addEdge, update, group] Full draw.io style string, e.g. "shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;". On update it REPLACES the style; prefer styleProps for small changes.

styleProps.description: draw.io style keys to set, merged into the existing/base style. Values are strings/numbers/booleans; null removes a key. Example: {"fillColor":"#dae8fc","strokeColor":"#6c8ebf","fontStyle":1}

parent.description: [addShape, addEdge, update, layout, insertXml] Container/group id. Omit for the default layer.

placement.description: [addShape] Position relative to an existing cell instead of x/y. Inherits that cell's parent.

data.description: [addShape, update] Custom string attributes (tooltip, link, metadata). null removes on update.

includeEdges.description: [delete] Also delete connected edges. Default true.

type.description: [layout] Automatic layout (draw.io's ELK engine). hierarchical = top-down flow; horizontalHierarchical = left-to-right. Lays out the children of `parent` (default: the page, or the common parent of `ids`); with `ids`, only those cells and the edges between them move.

xml.description: [insertXml, replaceAll] mxGraphModel XML or bare <mxCell> elements. Ids you choose are kept unless they collide (the result maps them). parent/source/target may reference existing cells.

selectResult.description: Select the changed cells afterwards. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: drawio_find_cells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the current page for cells by label text (case-insensitive substring or /regex/), kind, or style fragment. Returns compact matches with ids.

languageModelTools.name: drawio_select_cells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Select (and optionally scroll to and highlight) cells in the editor, e.g. to show the user what you are referring to.

languageModelTools.name: drawio_render_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render the current page (or only the given cells) to a PNG so you can visually check layout, overlaps and readability after editing.

languageModelTools.name: drawio_search_shapes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search draw.io's built-in shape libraries (thousands of shapes: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Cisco/network, UML, BPMN, ER, C4, flowchart, mockups, ...) and get each shape's exact style string and default size. ALWAYS use this before adding vendor icons or specialised shapes instead of guessing `shape=mxgraph...` names. Multi-cell templates (e.g. UML class, table) include xml for insertXml.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "aws lambda", "azure sql database", "kubernetes pod", "uml class".

languageModelTools.name: drawio_style_reference
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Concise reference for common draw.io style strings: basic shapes, edge styles and arrowheads, the default colour palette, containers/swimlanes, and text. For vendor icons use drawio_search_shapes.

languageModelTools.name: drawio_get_xml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the raw draw.io file XML (all pages). Only needed for exact copying of complex styles or multi-page questions; prefer drawio_get_diagram.

commands.title: Link Workspace Symbol With Selected Node

enumDescriptions: Models from VS Code's Language Model API (GitHub Copilot, ...). No API key needed.
Anthropic API with your own key.
Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, ...).
drawio-ai.provider.description: Default AI provider for the Draw.io AI chat panel. (The @drawio chat participant always uses the model selected in Copilot Chat.)

drawio-ai.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum number of tool-calling rounds per request.

drawio-ai.reviewChanges.markdownDescription: Show AI edits as pending changes (green = added, amber = changed, red = removed) that you keep or revert, instead of accepting them immediately. Changes are applied while pending, so the diagram and file already contain them until you revert.

drawio-ai.flashChanges.description: Briefly highlight cells changed by the AI.

drawio-ai.selectChangedCells.description: Select cells changed by the AI after each edit.

drawio-ai.maxCellsInContext.description: Maximum number of cells sent to the model when it reads the diagram.

drawio-ai.anthropic.model.description: Anthropic model id. Empty = newest model returned by the API (or pick one in the chat panel).

drawio-ai.anthropic.maxTokens.description: max_tokens for Anthropic responses. Large diagram edits need room for tool-call JSON.

drawio-ai.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (must serve `/chat/completions`). Examples: `https://YOUR-RESOURCE.openai.azure.com/openai/v1`, `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, `http://localhost:11434/v1`.

drawio-ai.openai.model.description: Model (or Azure deployment) name. Can also be picked in the chat panel.

drawio-ai.openai.authHeader.description: How to send the key: 'Authorization: Bearer' (OpenAI, OpenRouter) or 'api-key' header (Azure OpenAI).

drawio-ai.openai.supportsImages.description: Whether the selected model accepts images (enables the render-and-check tool).

drawio-ai.offline.title: Use Offline Mode
drawio-ai.offline.description: When enabled, the bundled instance of Draw.io is used.

drawio-ai.online-url.title: Online URL
drawio-ai.online-url.description: The app to use when offline mode is disabled.

drawio-ai.codeLinkActivated.title: Code Link Enabled
drawio-ai.codeLinkActivated.description: When activated, selecting a node will navigate to an associated code section.

drawio-ai.local-storage.title: Draw.io Local Storage
drawio-ai.local-storage.description: Only change this property if you know what you are doing. Manual changes to this property are not supported!

drawio-ai.simpleLabels.title: Use SimpleLabels
drawio-ai.simpleLabels.description: When enabled, no ForeignObjects are used in the svg.

enumDescriptions: The SVG always uses light colors.
The SVG adapts to the light or dark color scheme of the page that shows it.
The SVG always uses dark colors.
drawio-ai.svgAppearance.title: SVG Appearance
drawio-ai.svgAppearance.description: The appearance of `.drawio.svg` files and SVG exports. It does not depend on the theme of the editor.

drawio-ai.zoomFactor.title: Draw.io zoom factor
drawio-ai.zoomFactor.description: Defines the zoom factor for mouse wheel and trackpad zoom.

drawio-ai.globalVars.title: Draw.io global variables.
drawio-ai.globalVars.description: Defines global variables for system-wide placeholders using a JSON structure with key, value pairs. Keep the number of global variables small.

drawio-ai.resizeImages.title: Draw.io resize images.
drawio-ai.resizeImages.description: If set to true, images are resized automatically on paste. If not defined, the user will be asked to confirm the resize.

drawio-ai.showTooltipIcons.title: Show Tooltip Icons
drawio-ai.showTooltipIcons.description: Specifies whether tooltip icons are shown.

drawio-ai.showLinkIcons.title: Show Link Icons
drawio-ai.showLinkIcons.description: Specifies whether link icons are shown.

drawio-ai.showConnectHandle.title: Show Connect Handle
drawio-ai.showConnectHandle.description: Specifies whether the connect handle is shown on selected vertices.

drawio-ai.inline.minimalUI.description: Use minimal draw.io UI (hides sidebar, format panel, scrollbars)

drawio-ai.inline.diagramPadding.description: Padding (in pixels) around diagram content in the viewer and inline editor. Must be large enough to show selection handles (typically 20px).

file.description: The file path to the library. Must be absolute. You can use `${workspaceFolder}`.

drawio-ai.plugins.title: Plugins
drawio-ai.plugins.markdownDescription: Loads Draw.io plugins from the local filesystem.  See description of the `file` property. See [plugins documentation](https://github.com/MichaelDanCurtis/drawio-ai/blob/drawio-ai/docs/plugins.md).

drawio-ai.knownPlugins.title: Known Plugins
drawio-ai.knownPlugins.markdownDescription: List of allowed or denied plugins. The extension will read and write to this list based on what the used decides when loading specific plugins. See [plugins documentation](https://github.com/MichaelDanCurtis/drawio-ai/blob/drawio-ai/docs/plugins.md).

entryId.description: The id of the entry. A specfic entry can be enabled or deactivated in the editor.

libName.description: The name of the library in the shape overview.

file.description: The file path to the library. Must be absolute. You can use ${workspaceFolder}.

drawio-ai.customLibraries.title: Custom Libraries
drawio-ai.customLibraries.description: Configures the Draw.io editor to use custom libraries.

drawio-ai.styles.title: Styles
drawio-ai.styles.description: Defines an array of objects that contain the colours (fontColor, fillColor, strokeColor and gradientColor) for the Style tab of the format panel if the selection is empty. These objects can have a commonStyle (which is applied to both vertices and edges), vertexStyle (applied to vertices) and edgeStyle (applied to edges), and a graph with background and gridColor. An empty object means apply the default colors

drawio-ai.colorNames.title: Color Names
drawio-ai.colorNames.description: Names for colors, eg. {‘FFFFFF’: ‘White’, ‘000000’: ‘Black’} that are used as tooltips (uppercase, no leading # for the colour codes)

drawio-ai.presetColors.title: Preset Colors
drawio-ai.presetColors.description: Color codes for the upper palette in the color dialog.

items.description: Use hex codes without # at the beginning only (FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

drawio-ai.customColorSchemes.title: Custom Color Schemes
drawio-ai.customColorSchemes.markdownDescription: Available color schemes in the style section at the top of the format panel. See example [here](https://www.diagrams.net/doc/faq/custom-colours-confluence-cloud#default-colour-schemes---format-panel)

items.description: Represents a page of color schemes.

title.description: Title of the color used in tooltips.

fill.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

stroke.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

gradient.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

font.description: Use hex codes with # at the beginning (#FFFFFF for absolute white, for example).

drawio-ai.customFonts.title: Custom Fonts
drawio-ai.customFonts.description: Configures the Draw.io editor to use custom fonts.

drawio-ai.theme.title: Draw.io Theme
drawio-ai.theme.description: The theme to use for the Draw.io editor. Use "automatic" to automatically choose a Draw.io theme that matches your current VS Code theme.

drawio-ai.appearance.title: Draw.io Appearance
drawio-ai.appearance.description: The appearance to use for the Draw.io editor. Use "automatic" to automatically choose a Draw.io theme that matches your current VS Code theme.
